$comment: What this repository contributes to a running stack, and what a check may
believe about it. `checked` is proved against this repository by
crates/web/tests/manifest.rs in this repository's own CI; `declared` is a
statement nobody can verify and carries its own `why`.
RUST PUTS ITS UNIT TESTS INSIDE THE SOURCE FILE, AND THAT CHANGES THE READER.
Go's siblings skip `*_test.go` and are done. Here a `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`
sits at the bottom of the same file, so the reader cuts each file at the
first module-level `#[cfg(test)]` and takes only what precedes it. Eight
GENARYX_ names exist only after that line, and declaring one would put a test
fixture into this estate's idea of how to configure a console.
The two Rust manifests written before this one were checked for the same
mistake: TOKENFUSE_ALLOW_STUB and TRAILRYX_DEMO_STORE both sit in product
code, so both are right. That was measured rather than assumed.
GENARYX_COPILOT_KEY IS THE INTERESTING ONE, AND IT IS NOT DECLARED.
stack-k8s sets it, so it looks like a variable this repository reads. It is
not. The code reads GENARYX_COPILOT_API_KEY_REF, whose VALUE is a reference
such as `env:GENARYX_COPILOT_KEY`, and then reads whatever variable that
reference names. So the deployment chooses the name and this repository never
sees it. `GENARYX_COPILOT_KEY` appears here only inside a test that parses
the reference form.
THE UI IS A DIRECTORY IT IS GIVEN, NOT SOMETHING IT CARRIES. `--ui` is
optional and omitting it serves the API alone. What fills that directory is
`apps/web`, a TypeScript build in this same repository and a toolchain this
manifest's check knows nothing about, which is why the UI is declared rather
than checked.

the_component_name_is_not_the_binary_nam.why: estate.json calls it `console` and every deployment installs it under that name; the binary is `genaryx-web`. Recorded rather than renamed.

the_secret_is_read_by_reference.why: The copilot's key is not read from a variable this repository names. It reads the REFERENCE and then the variable the reference points at, so the name is the deployment's choice. stack-k8s picks GENARYX_COPILOT_KEY. Nothing here can check a name it never sees.

the_ui_is_a_directory_it_is_given.why: Optional: omitted, it serves the API alone. The directory is built from apps/web, a TypeScript toolchain in this same repository that this check knows nothing about.

doctor_is_the_other_half.why: The same binary, run by a person to check a box rather than to serve it. No launcher schedules it, so it is a subcommand here and not a component of its own.
